- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the apartment above the settlement in Erethel, there lived a reclusive writer known as Theyla Keth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Theyla preferred to spend most of her time alone with her robots and Richard Bot, who assisted her with her errands.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Theyla submitted her recordings to the Library branch and retreated to her home to recover from the effort.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] One day, while at her desk, the walls shook, and she heard an aircraft landing on the roof of the mud brick apartment complex.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Frustrated by the disturbance, Theyla donned her hooded cloak and grabbed her walking stick to confront the intruder.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Theyla froze in shock as she saw Val Renberg standing before her, backlit by the sun.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val Renberg was not wearing her usual Co-Op flight suit or white and gold clothing, but rather plain brown leathers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val's angular face and severe hairstyle had remained the same, as had her dark green gaze and goggles pushed up onto her forehead.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val looked at Theyla briefly and then away again, her lip quivering slightly as she spoke Theyla's name.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Theyla trembled as Val took her hands and pulled her into a tight embrace.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The touch of Val's hand made Theyla's heart race, and she was acutely aware of how vulnerable she was in her barefoot state.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val suggested they go inside, and Theyla led her back up the stairs to her apartment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Theyla showed Val the kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, and sitting room as they walked through the rooms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When they sat down on the sofa in the living room, Theyla asked Val why she had come.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val revealed that she had quit DSES and cashed out her pension, staying at Novaya Waypoint while waiting for her hazard pay to cash out so she could buy a ship.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val had come to see Theyla before she left.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Val reached into her leather jacket and produced a small folded square of paper, setting it down on the table in front of them.
